name: cache-cold-compact
description: Compacts an idle session shortly before its prompt cache goes cold, so the next prompt re-caches a summary instead of the whole transcript

ttlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after the last response: 60 for the 1-hour cache, 5 for the 5-minute cache

leadMinutes.title: Compact this many minutes before the cache goes cold
leadMinutes.description: Lead time before the TTL lapses; never less than half the TTL of idle time

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context to bother compacting (tokens)
minContextTokens.description: Smaller conversations are cheap to re-cache and are left alone

preemptPercent.title: Compact with the handoff prompt at this % of the context window
preemptPercent.description: Of the auto-compact window (CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, else the model's), checked at the end of each turn so the plugin's handoff compaction beats the engine's generic one (whose prompt cc-plugin-sec-default keeps plugins from changing on Team/Enterprise accounts). 75 sits just under the engine's summary precompute; always capped below the engine's own threshold; 0 turns it off

showStatus.title: Show the countdown in the status line
showStatus.description: Pins 'auto-compact in Nm' under the prompt while armed
